pages.title: Dedication

segments.speaker: Leola
segments.text:
To my children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren, who have been the threads that bind my life together.

To every hand that has ever held a crochet hook, seeking to create something beautiful.

And especially to those who have yet to discover the joy of creating with yarn and needle - may this story inspire your journey.

With love and faith, - Sister Lee

pages.title: A Note from Leola

segments.speaker: Leola
segments.text: Every stitch tells a story. Mistakes are not failures but opportunities for growth. Most importantly, we are all connected - stitched together in a pattern larger than ourselves.

pages.captionText: Every stitch tells a story. Mistakes are not failures but opportunities for growth. Most importantly, we are all connected - stitched together in a pattern larger than ourselves.

pages.title: Chapter One - The Magic Begins

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The little bell over the shop door gave a bright ding-a-ling. Morning sunshine slipped in right behind a woman and stretched itself long.

pages.title: A Shop Full of Possibility
